meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 你要求定制 NanoClaw 时,它会先提问澄清需求,再调用对应的安装或配置命令(如添加渠道、改触发词、加集成)来修改设置,之后告诉你如何验证。
howto.when: 当你提出添加聊天渠道(如 Telegram、Slack)、修改触发词、接入外部服务等定制要求时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Telegram 加为输入渠道
say.note: 它会运行 /add-telegram 并询问配置问题。

say.text: 给某个代理组改一下触发规则
say.note: 它会询问目标代理组和新的触发条件。

say.text: 添加 Gmail 作为 MCP 集成

howto.what_en: When you ask to customize NanoClaw, it first asks clarifying questions, then runs the appropriate install or config commands (e.g. adding channels, changing triggers, adding integrations) and tells you how to verify.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a chat channel (like Telegram or Slack), change triggers, connect an external service, or make other customizations.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel
say_en.note: It runs /add-telegram and asks config questions.

say_en.text: Change the trigger rules for an agent group
say_en.note: It asks which group and the new conditions.

say_en.text: Add Gmail as an MCP integration
say_en.note: It runs /add-gmail-tool or configures the MCP server.
